title: vicia cracca var. canescens
intro: Vicia cracca var. canescens, commonly known as hairy vetch, is a plant species within the pea family (Fabaceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Vicia cracca var. canescens include stimulating digestion, treating skin conditions, and supporting immune function, among other uses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
